note: Second chest, opened by the operator while the agent only recorded. Same zones as the first chest within a few pixels, but the marker ran faster and the stop decelerates.

marker.motion: constant in mid-flight, eased at the bounces

stop.observed: the marker glides to rest instead of halting
stop.implication: a tap timed to land the marker on the zone edge overshoots by about 40 px; the policy must aim short by the overshoot

attemptsCounter.meaning: chances left for this chest; a pass never stopped consumes one
